dedupe_keys.name: reproduction archive uncertainty aware grid planning in the real world two stage adaptive robust optimization for capacity expansion california case study

description: Gabriel Mantegna publishes a California grid-planning replication archive built from the CPUC 2026–2027 TPP RESOLVE dataset. Zenodo supplies model inputs, translation code, expected outputs and instructions under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The archive covers four main planning cases and 312 stress-test cases. It can benchmark deterministic against adaptive-robust generation, storage and transmission capacity decisions using the linked GenX fork. The catalogue contains general model-genx; this release supplies California-specific cases and a fork dependency. A limitation is that the archive uses a newer CPUC input vintage than the paper and omits split-budget cases. Reproduction needs Julia 1.11.3, Gurobi 12 with separate licensing, and roughly 50–600 GB of memory depending on the case. These are modelled plans, not adopted utility investments. No archive was downloaded or optimisation solved.
